canonical.title: A Michelin Weekend in Los Angeles

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-Star Restaurants in Los Angeles
siblings.summary: Los Angeles has 5 restaurants with 2+ Michelin stars: Providence and Somni hold the city's first-ever three stars; Hayato, Mélisse, and Vespertine each hold two.

siblings.title: Things to Do in Los Angeles
siblings.summary: A scannable, cited guide to LA's best landmarks, neighborhoods, beaches, museums, casual eats and logistics — built for a weekend anchored on a great dinner.

siblings.title: IT Conferences and Tech Events in Los Angeles
siblings.summary: A dated calendar of major IT conferences and tech events in Los Angeles for 2026, from AWS Summit (June 10) to SIGGRAPH (July 19–23) to a16z Tech Week (Oct 12–18).
